# PDF agent tools

<!-- Generated by tools/agent-tool-docs.mjs from the tool definitions. Do not edit by hand. -->

9 tools, as the model sees them: the name it calls, the description it is given, and every argument its schema accepts.

## `delete_page`

Delete the given page (takes effect on save; the user can undo before saving).

| argument | type    | required | description           |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------- |
| `page`   | integer | yes      | Page number (1-based) |

## `fill_form_field`

Fill in one form field. For text/choice/radio fields pass value (radio: the exportValue; choice: an option exportValue); for checkboxes pass checked.

| argument  | type    | required | description                        |
| --------- | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `name`    | string  | yes      | Field name (from list_form_fields) |
| `value`   | string  |          | Value for text/choice/radio fields |
| `checked` | boolean |          | Checked state for checkboxes       |

## `get_outline`

Read the document outline (bookmarks) tree, including entry titles. Returns empty if the document has no outline.

No arguments.

## `goto_page`

Scroll the reading view to the given page so the user can see it.

| argument | type    | required | description           |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------- |
| `page`   | integer | yes      | Page number (1-based) |

## `list_form_fields`

List all form fields in the document (name/type/current value/options/page). Must be called before filling forms to learn the fields.

No arguments.

## `markup_text`

Add a markup (highlight/underline/strikeout) to a text passage on the given page. text must be a verbatim fragment that actually exists on that page (confirm with read_pages or search_text first); by default only the first occurrence is marked, all=true marks every occurrence on that page.

| argument | type                                      | required | description                                                     |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `page`   | integer                                   | yes      | Page number (1-based)                                           |
| `text`   | string                                    | yes      | Verbatim text fragment from the page                            |
| `type`   | `highlight` \| `underline` \| `strikeout` | yes      | Markup type                                                     |
| `all`    | boolean                                   |          | Whether to mark every occurrence on the page; defaults to false |

## `read_pages`

Read the text content of a page range (with [Page N] markers). Read the relevant pages before answering questions; at most 10 pages per call, over-long output is truncated.

| argument | type    | required | description                                                          |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `start`  | integer | yes      | Start page number (1-based)                                          |
| `end`    | integer |          | End page number (inclusive); if omitted, only the start page is read |

## `rotate_page`

Rotate the given page 90 degrees clockwise or counterclockwise.

| argument    | type              | required | description                                |
| ----------- | ----------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `page`      | integer           | yes      | Page number (1-based)                      |
| `direction` | `left` \| `right` | yes      | left = counterclockwise, right = clockwise |

## `search_text`

Search the full text for a string; returns the page number and a context excerpt for each hit. Prefer this when locating which page something is on.

| argument | type   | required | description                           |
| -------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `query`  | string | yes      | Text to search for (case-insensitive) |
